messages:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: scheduled Dedicated/Private rollout for customer 'Lighthouse' starting 2026-05-10 02:00 UTC. Target slices: slice-7..slice-11. Canary = slice-7. Stagger = 10m per slice. Pinned model/runtime = v2.3.1-inference (no auto-upgrade). KMS note: customer reported a KMS rotation at ~02:30 UTC — flagged for ops. Release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-05/lighthouse-v2.3.1

maya: Thanks deploy-bot. @sre-oncall can you confirm KMS collision risk? If rotate hits during canary we may need to pause.

chris: Can confirm customer KMS rotate is a soft rotation (staged) — they said 02:30 but some keys live-rotate across minutes. Risk: short auth errors during keyswap.

sre-oncall: @maya @chris thanks. Recommend we: 1) Move canary start earlier by 10m (01:50 UTC) or 2) add an explicit pause on slice-8 if we see any auth failures. Prefer option 2 to avoid interfering with customer's ops window.

maya: Option 2 sounds safer. We want zero-change if customer rotates. Add a health gate that checks KMS auth for 5 consecutive requests before proceeding to next slice.

prod-ops: We can add the gate. Proposed health-gate check in rollout config:

```
health_gate:
  type: k8s_http
  probe: /health/kms-auth
  success_threshold: 5
  interval_seconds: 10
```

prod-ops: If probe fails, pause rollout and notify #eng-oncall and the release thread.

eli: Quick q — if canary (slice-7) reports token errors, do we roll back to previous runtime or just pause and retry? Need clear rollback criteria.

jordan: Suggest rollback criteria: any of the following within canary window -> immediate rollback of canary slice and abort further slices:
- >5% 5xx or auth failures over 5 minutes
- latency > 3x baseline for 3 consecutive probes
- failed inference correctness check for golden prompt set (>=2 regressed prompts)

chris: +1 to those. Also add an automatic drain+revert for the canary process to ensure KV cache state consistent: revert to v2.3.0 if rollback triggered.

maya: Noted. Update rollout config to pin fallback_version=v2.3.0 and set automatic drain on rollback. Also add an emergency manual-override channel: @release-emergency.

deploy-bot: Updated rollout config saved to /runbooks/releases/lighthouse-2026-05-10.json. Deploy command queued. Trigger when ready:

```
deploybot run --customer lighthouse --slices slice-7..slice-11 --stagger 10m --canary slice-7 --config /runbooks/releases/lighthouse-2026-05-10.json
```

maya: Can we move the scheduled start to 01:55 UTC (10m earlier) to give a little headroom before 02:30 KMS ops? Still okay with pause gate as second defense. @prod-ops?

prod-ops: Moving to 01:55 is fine. I'll update the calendar and notify the customer. Also enabling verbose KMS auth logs for the 02:00–03:00 window.

sre-oncall: I'll be on call 01:45–03:15 and will watch SLO dashboards + auth logs. If we see errors I will pause and escalate.

eli: One more: confirm the canary golden prompt checks are run locally (no egress). Are the evals included in rollout window?

chris: Yes, golden prompt set runs inside the customer's VPC in the canary slice. We report a pass/fail to deploy-bot only. No external traffic.

maya: Great. With those updates we are green. Final checklist for go/no-go:
- Config pinned: v2.3.1-inference, fallback v2.3.0 ✅
- Health gate: KMS auth probe 5/5 ✅
- Canary window moved to 01:55 UTC ✅
- On-call coverage and verbose logging ✅
- Customer notified and acknowledged ✅

jordan: I'll keep the rollback playbook at hand. If we abort after canary, we'll run the revert + postmortem template and reach out to account team.

maya: Alright, initiating deploy in 10m. @deploy-bot kick when ready. :rocket:
